label: Account & license
tip: Sign in or out. Talk DAT! is free; an account only keeps your preferences in step.

label: Words & phrases
tip: Teach the app names and jargon it should spell correctly.

label: Race
tip: Runs cloud and on-device speech head-to-head to see which suits you.

label: Mic Doctor
tip: Step-by-step checkup when your microphone sounds wrong or too quiet.

label: Share an idea
tip: Send a feature request straight to the maker.

label: Active brand
tip: Shows which speech service is listening now; change it on the Speech page.

label: Active model
tip: Shows the exact speech model in use right now.

label: Language
tip: The language you dictate in, like en-US; change it if you speak another language.

label: Auto Cleanup
tip: How much tidying your words get; high removes ums and stumbles, none keeps everything.

label: Settings menu theme
tip: Pick this window's colors; the Colors tab shows live previews of every theme.

label: App font
tip: Changes the typeface used across the whole app, applied instantly.

label: Installed version
tip: The version you are running; handy when asking for help.

label: Latest seen
tip: The newest version the updater has spotted online.

label: Updater
tip: Click to check for and install the newest version now.

label: Check for updates on start
tip: Looks for new versions each time the app opens; turn off to skip.

label: Auto-download update installer when a new release exists
tip: Fetches updates in the background so installing later takes seconds.

label: Save local transcript history
tip: Keeps a private copy of your dictations on this computer; off keeps no record.

label: Play start and stop sounds
tip: A soft sound when recording starts and ends; turn off for silence.

label: Auto paste transcript
tip: Types your words into the app you are using; off means copy only.

label: Smart leading space
tip: Adds a space before pasted text when needed so words never stick together.

label: Update channel
tip: stable gets tested releases; beta gets new features earlier with more rough edges.

label: Enable user plugins (loads Python files from the plugins folder)
tip: Runs your own add-ons; leave off unless you wrote or trust them.

label: Enable local control API for automations (127.0.0.1 only)
tip: Lets programs on this computer control Talk DAT!; leave off unless you automate.

label: Opacity
tip: How solid the floating pill looks; lower is more see-through.

label: Hover fade delay ms
tip: How long your mouse hovers before the pill fades out of the way.

label: Hover fade opacity
tip: How faint the pill becomes while your mouse is over it.

label: Active pill width
tip: Pill width while dictating; enlarge if it is hard to see.

label: Active pill height
tip: Pill height while dictating; enlarge if it is hard to see.

label: Active window width
tip: Width of the pill's window while active; usually leave alone.

label: Active window height
tip: Height of the pill's window while active; usually leave alone.

label: Resting width
tip: Pill width when idle; smaller stays further out of your way.

label: Resting height
tip: Pill height when idle; smaller stays further out of your way.

label: Bottom margin
tip: Gap between the pill and the edge of your screen.

label: Active frame ms
tip: Animation refresh while dictating; higher numbers use less computer power.

label: Idle frame ms
tip: Animation refresh while idle; higher numbers use less computer power.

label: Resize frame ms
tip: Speed of each step when the pill grows or shrinks.

label: Resize steps
tip: How many steps the grow-and-shrink animation takes; more looks smoother.

label: Active loop seconds
tip: How long one cycle of the dictating animation lasts.

label: Idle loop seconds
tip: How long one cycle of the idle animation lasts.

label: Result hold ms
tip: How long finished text stays shown on the pill.

label: Error hold ms
tip: How long error messages stay visible on the pill.

label: Wave loop start
tip: Where the wave animation begins its repeat; purely cosmetic.

label: Wave loop end
tip: Where the wave animation ends its repeat; purely cosmetic.

label: Show overlay on start
tip: Shows the pill as soon as the app opens; off hides it until needed.

label: Always same bottom position
tip: Keeps the pill anchored to one spot instead of remembering where you dragged it.

label: Do not steal focus
tip: Stops the pill taking the keyboard away from the app you are typing in.

label: Hide pill over fullscreen media
tip: Hides the pill during fullscreen video or games.

label: Show pill while dictating over fullscreen apps
tip: Brings the pill back while you are actually speaking, even in fullscreen.

label: Fullscreen check ms
tip: How often it checks for fullscreen apps; lower reacts faster.

label: Pill position
tip: Which screen edge the pill sits on.

label: Reduce motion (skip pill animations)
tip: Turns animations off; good if motion distracts you or the PC is slow.

label: Appear on the monitor I'm using (follow the active window)
tip: The pill follows you to whichever monitor you are working on.

label: History limit
tip: Most dictations kept in history; 0 means keep everything.

label: History storage
tip: Plain text file or a searchable local database for your history.

label: Redact emails, phone numbers, cards, SSNs before pasting
tip: Blanks out personal details before text lands anywhere; use for sensitive work.

label: Censor profanity
tip: Replaces swear words with asterisks in your transcripts.

label: Theme
tip: Click any color bar to switch the whole app to that theme instantly.

label: Microphone
tip: Which mic the app listens to; pick your headset if the wrong one is used.

label: Input gain boost
tip: Turn the knob up if the app hears you too quietly.

label: Whisper-quiet mode (extra gain for soft speech)
tip: Extra volume boost for speaking softly, like in a shared office.

label: Quiet mode boost
tip: How much extra loudness whisper-quiet mode adds.

label: Mic check
tip: Records one second and tells you whether your mic level is healthy.

label: Wake word activation (local beta, openWakeWord ...)
tip: Say a phrase like 'hey Jarvis' to start dictating; audio never leaves this computer.

label: Wake word model
tip: Which wake phrase the app listens for.

label: Paste method
tip: How text lands in your app; auto works nearly everywhere, try others if pasting misbehaves.

label: Typing interval ms
tip: Delay between typed characters in typing mode; raise it if letters go missing.

label: Clipboard paste delay ms
tip: Small wait before pasting; raise it if slow apps miss the paste.

label: Activation sound
tip: The sound played when recording starts; preview and pick your favorite.

label: Release sound
tip: The sound played when recording stops; preview and pick your favorite.

label: Dictation preset
tip: One-click timing bundles: Balanced is safe, Snappy feels faster, Long-form waits for slow speech.

label: Tail capture ms
tip: Extra listening after you release the key so your last word is not cut off.

label: Minimum capture ms
tip: Shortest recording that counts; ignores accidental key taps.

label: Hold debounce ms
tip: Ignores tiny accidental key releases while you hold to talk.

label: Hands-free max seconds
tip: Longest a hands-free session can run before stopping itself.

label: Hands-free no speech
tip: Stops hands-free if you never start speaking within this many seconds.

label: Hands-free silence
tip: Stops hands-free after this many seconds of silence.

label: Hold max seconds
tip: Longest a hold-to-talk session can run before stopping itself.

label: Hold no speech
tip: Stops a hold session if no speech is heard for this long.

label: Hold silence
tip: Stops a hold session after this much silence.

label: Keep your previous clipboard after pasting (off = keep the dictation on the clipboard)
tip: Puts whatever you copied earlier back on the clipboard after your words paste.

label: Spoken press-enter command
tip: Say 'press enter' at the end and the app sends the message for you.

label: Instant correction
tip: How corrections replace already-typed text; Automatic picks the least jarring way.

label: Mute speaker output while recording
tip: Silences your speakers while you talk so music is not transcribed.

label: Retry failed capture from local audio
tip: If transcription fails, tries again from the saved recording so nothing is lost.

label: Protect every voice session locally
tip: Always on: each session is saved privately on this computer so words cannot be lost.

label: Protected session limit (minimum 5)
tip: How many recent recordings to keep for recovery; at least five.

label: Trigger style
tip: One button or two: hold while talking, tap on and off, or both.

label: Push-to-talk
tip: The keys you hold down while speaking; release to finish.

label: Hands-free toggle
tip: Tap once to start dictating, tap again to stop.

label: Command mode
tip: Shortcut for speaking commands to your computer instead of writing text.

label: Panic stop
tip: Instantly stops everything: recording, transcribing, and pasting.

label: Cancel
tip: Throws away the current recording without pasting anything.

label: Paste last
tip: Pastes your most recent dictation again.

label: Copy last
tip: Copies your most recent dictation to the clipboard.

label: Polish
tip: Rewrites your last dictation more cleanly using AI.

label: Prompt engineer
tip: Turns your last dictation into a well-structured AI prompt.

label: Turn to list
tip: Reformats your last dictation into a tidy list.

label: Copy cleanup diff
tip: Copies a before-and-after view showing exactly what cleanup changed.

label: Scratchpad
tip: Opens a notepad window that collects your dictations.

label: Translate last dictation
tip: Translates the last thing you said into your chosen language.

label: Auto-translate on/off
tip: Switches automatic translation of every dictation on or off.

label: Pin last transcript
tip: Keeps the last transcript on screen so you cannot lose it.

label: Meeting mode
tip: Starts long-running capture built for meetings.

label: Smart formatting: structure every dictation
tip: Automatically adds punctuation, capitals, and lists to everything you dictate.

label: Formatting engine
tip: auto picks the best available; ai uses your AI provider; heuristic works offline; off disables.

label: Protect numbers, links, quotes, and intent during AI cleanup
tip: Stops AI cleanup from ever changing numbers, links, quotes, or your meaning.

label: Enable transforms (polish, tone, list)
tip: Turns on the rewrite tools like Polish and Turn to list.

label: AI rewrite provider
tip: Which AI powers rewrites; none turns AI off, ollama runs free on your computer.

label: Local formatting quality
tip: Bigger local tiers format better but take longer; Realtime is the fast default.

label: AI model (blank = <local formatter model> for Ollama)
tip: Exact AI model name to use; leave blank for the recommended one.

label: Formatting time budget ms
tip: Longest the AI may spend formatting before built-in rules take over.

label: AI API key
tip: The key for your paid AI account, if your provider needs one.

label: AI API base (optional)
tip: Custom server address for the AI; leave blank unless told otherwise.

label: Translate to
tip: The language used when you run a translate transform.

label: Get / update Ollama
tip: Opens the download page for the free on-device AI engine.

label: Download formatter model
tip: Downloads the local AI formatter (about 1.4 GB) so formatting works offline.

label: Use realtime recommended
tip: Resets formatting to the fast recommended setup.

label: Custom transforms JSON
tip: Advanced: define your own rewrite commands here.

label: Voice shortcuts
tip: Say a saved phrase and the full text pastes, like your email signature.

label: Words, one per line
tip: Names and jargon the recognizer should know; paste lists split by commas or lines.

label: Replacements JSON
tip: Advanced: always swap one exact phrase for another after transcription.

label: Suggest from history
tip: Scans your past dictations and suggests words worth adding.

label: Export pack...
tip: Saves your words, replacements, and shortcuts to a file to share or back up.

label: Import pack...
tip: Loads a saved pack of words and shortcuts onto this computer.

label: Enable translation
tip: Master switch for all translation features.

label: Auto-translate every dictation
tip: Everything you dictate is translated before it is pasted.

label: Translation route
tip: translation runs privately on this computer.

label: Translation source
tip: The language you speak; Auto detects it from your dictation.

label: Translation target
tip: The language your words are translated into.

label: Translation quality
tip: Bigger models translate better but download more and run slower.

label: Translation register
tip: Tone of the translation: natural, formal, informal, or word-for-word.

label: Preserve paragraphs, lists, numbers, links, and email addresses
tip: Keeps layout, numbers, links, and emails untouched while translating.

label: Open translation workspace
tip: Opens the full translation window for longer text.

label: Manage local model
tip: Install or remove the on-device translation model.

label: Request another language
tip: Ask for a language that is not listed yet.

label: Glossary - one exact source => target pair per line
tip: Your fixed translations: each line forces one phrase to translate a specific way.

label: Speech model routing (Local / Bring your own)
tip: Pick who does the listening: private on-device, or your own provider account.

label: Brand
tip: The company whose speech service you want to use.

label: Model
tip: The specific speech model from that company; newer usually hears better.

label: Mode / trim
tip: Variant of the model, like streaming or a smaller faster cut.

label: Secret / credential
tip: The key from your provider account; stored safely on this computer.

label: API base
tip: The provider's server address; keep the default unless support says otherwise.

label: Provider links
tip: Quick buttons to the provider's login, API-key, and documentation pages.

label: Docs
tip: Link to the selected provider's documentation.

label: Advanced options JSON
tip: Extra provider settings; leave empty unless a support doc asks for them.

label: Open local model manager
tip: Jumps to the page where on-device models are downloaded and activated.

label: Compare researched models
tip: Opens a side-by-side guide of speech models we have tested.

label: Automatically download the selected local model (recommended)
tip: Fetches a chosen model on first use so dictation just works.

label: Compare ready and upcoming models
tip: Opens the model guide comparing quality, size, and speed.

label: Use
tip: Makes this model the active on-device listener.

label: Download
tip: Downloads this model now instead of waiting for first use; retries resume, not restart.

label: Delete
tip: Removes this model's downloaded files to free disk space.

label: Remove
tip: Takes your custom model off the list.

label: Add your own model
tip: Paste a Hugging Face model id or folder path to dictate with your own model.

label: Deepgram API key
tip: Your Deepgram account key; only needed when using Deepgram directly.

label: Deepgram model
tip: Which Deepgram model transcribes; nova-3 is the strong default.

label: Sample rate
tip: Audio samples per second; keep 16000 unless a support doc says otherwise.

label: Channels
tip: Mono or stereo capture; keep 1 for dictation.

label: Encoding
tip: Raw audio format sent to the provider; keep linear16.

label: Endpointing ms
tip: Silence length before the service decides a phrase has ended.

label: Utterance end ms
tip: Silence length before a whole thought is marked finished.

label: Smart format
tip: Provider formats dates, times, and numbers nicely on its own.

label: Punctuation
tip: Provider inserts periods, commas, and question marks for you.

label: Interim results
tip: Shows live partial words while you are still speaking.

label: VAD speech events
tip: Provider signals when it hears speech start and stop.

label: Include provider filler words
tip: Keeps ums and uhs in the transcript instead of dropping them.

label: Dictation mode
tip: Say punctuation aloud, like 'comma', and get the symbol.

label: Numerals
tip: Writes numbers as digits (3) instead of words (three).

label: Deepgram MIP opt-out
tip: Keeps your audio out of Deepgram's improvement program; leave on for privacy.

label: Extra Deepgram params JSON
tip: Advanced extra request options; leave empty unless support asks.

label: Export diagnostics ZIP
tip: Bundles logs into a ZIP you can send when reporting a problem.

label: Backup settings...
tip: Saves all your settings into one ZIP file.

label: Restore backup...
tip: Brings settings back from a backup ZIP; restart afterwards to load them.

label: Race: cloud vs your machine
tip: Runs both speech routes on the same audio to see which wins for you.

label: Save
tip: Writes every change on every tab to disk.

label: Status
tip: Opens the live status window.

label: History
tip: Opens your dictation history.

label: Scratchpad
tip: Opens the scratchpad notepad.

label: Close
tip: Closes settings; warns first if you have unsaved changes.

label: Start over...
tip: Opens a reset picker to return settings to defaults; nothing resets without asking.
